The '''Ramordia system''' was located in the [[Majoor sector/Legends|Majoor sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of the [[Trailing Sectors/Legends|Trailing Sectors]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was situated on the [[Super-hyperroute/Legends|super-hyperroute]] known as the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]], specifically the section [[Star map/Legends|charted]] by the [[Scout/Legends|explorer]] [[Freia Kallea/Legends|Freia Kallea]] between [[3703 BBY]] and [[3702 BBY]]. The [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] route connected the [[Star system/Legends|system]] to the [[Majoor system/Legends|Majoor system]] as well as the [[Arrgaw system/Legends|Arrgaw system]]<ref name="TEA" /> in the [[Kira sector/Legends|Kira sector]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The Ramordia system was the origin point of the material known as [[Ramordian silk]].<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|III|77|Ramordian silk}}</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=[[Ramordian silk]]|system=Ramordia [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Ramordia system was established in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square N-15.<ref name="TEA" />
